questions.q: What are the three levels of the Goodness Pyramid, bottom to top?
questions.why: Lesson 1 lays out truth as the base, compassion in the middle and wholeness at the peak.

questions.q: What do most employers focus on when hiring, according to the summary?
questions.why: The overview says most employers value skills over values, which hurts both people and business.

questions.q: Which quality sits at the base of the Goodness Pyramid?
a: Truth, built from humility, self-awareness and integrity
Compassion, built from openness and empathy
Wholeness, built from wisdom and love
Loyalty, built from trust and consistency
questions.why: Lesson 1 says truth is foundational because without it everything falls apart.

questions.q: What is the 24x3 rule for developing openness?
a: Wait 24 seconds, minutes or hours before responding to an idea
Spend 24 minutes a day listening to a colleague
Ask three questions before offering your view
questions.why: Lesson 2 offers the 24x3 rule as a way to fight negativity and let optimism shine.

questions.q: What does wholeness mean at the top of the pyramid?
a: Seeking to improve through wisdom, love and respect
Being liked by everyone on your team
questions.why: Lesson 3 says good people seek wholeness, which in business means love, respect and wisdom.
